meta.name: Scheduled jobs
meta.description: HTTP calls, SQL tasks, sandboxed scripts and module tasks on a schedule, with retries, run history, live logs and alerts

runJob.name: Run a scheduled job
runJob.description: Runs one of your scheduled jobs now, as if someone pressed "Run now"; the request links to the run.
runJob.jobHelp: Runs with the job's own configuration, retries and alerts.

scheduler-viewer.name: Scheduled jobs viewer
scheduler-viewer.description: See jobs, run history, logs and the monitoring dashboard

scheduler-operator.name: Scheduled jobs operator
scheduler-operator.description: Create HTTP jobs and jobs of module task types; edit, run and cancel own and team jobs; run or cancel any job

scheduler-admin.name: Scheduled jobs administrator
scheduler-admin.description: Everything in Scheduled jobs, including SQL and script jobs

permissions.jobsRead: See scheduled jobs, run history, logs and the monitoring dashboard
permissions.jobsCreate: Create jobs; edit, run, cancel and delete jobs they own or their group owns
permissions.jobsManage: Edit, enable, disable and delete any job
permissions.sqlRun: Create and edit SQL jobs (statements on data connections)
permissions.scriptsManage: Create and edit script jobs (code that runs in the script sandbox)

settings.allowedHosts: Private hosts HTTP jobs may call
settings.allowedHostsHelp: One host name or *.suffix per line. Private, loopback and internal addresses are refused unless the host is listed here.
settings.retentionDaysHelp: Runs and their logs older than this are deleted every night. The latest run of each job is always kept.
settings.misfireGraceMinutesHelp: A scheduled run missed while the scheduler was down still runs once if it is no later than this; older ones are logged as missed.

form.cycle: These jobs would wait for each other forever: {path}
form.timeoutHint: The run is stopped and marked timed out after this.

concurrencyHint.skip: If the previous run is still going, the new one is skipped.
concurrencyHint.queue: If the previous run is still going, the new one waits for it.

form.onFailure: Notify the owner and owner group when a run fails

form.enabledHint: Disabled jobs keep their history but don't run on their schedule.
form.advancedHint: Time limit, retries, overlapping runs and automatic disabling. The defaults suit most jobs.
form.runFirstHint: Opens this period's work right away instead of waiting for the first scheduled run.
